answer: In this PoA design, equivocations linked across k coordinated identities incur aggregate penalties proportional to k², so splitting one operator across sybils cannot dilute accountability. Detection also forfeits bonded escrow and triggers asymmetric collateral depreciation, making swarm-wide capital loss compound with an exponential multiplier as k grows. A whisper of coordination can become a gale of liability, while the trellis of shared evidence links identities to the same event.
